reviews.title: Great App Ruined by Bugs and Nonexistent Support
reviews.text:
We used Homer a few years ago and had a great experience, which makes the current state of the app especially disappointing. It clearly needs a major update to address ongoing bugs.

The app is essentially unusable for us. Most of the time, it won’t open at all—it either freezes on the home screen or displays an error message. I’ve contacted customer support multiple times and have yet to receive a response from an actual person.

What makes this even more frustrating is that I paid for a full year subscription and cannot use the service I paid for. I’ve repeatedly asked Homer to either fix the issues so we can use the app on our iPhone or refund the subscription, but my requests have gone unanswered.

Based on our previous experience, I know this app has the potential to be great, but I would not recommend subscribing in its current state. Don’t let the positive reviews fool you. Until Homer fixes these major technical issues and improves its customer support, it simply isn’t worth paying for.

reviews.title: Mostly stimulating content rather than learning - charged me when signed up for trial
reviews.text:
I genuinely dislike this app. I would like to see more learning activities, but it’s mostly just videos, songs, stories, coloring pages and placing stickers. It’s more like watching TV than a learning game. And we continually get the same content in his daily moose lessons. I’m so sick of the same annoying cake video over and over. I do understand kids learn through play and through repetition, but this doesn’t seem like that. It just feels like content for them to stare at.
Another HUGE issue is that I never even wanted to buy this. We signed up for the week trial, but when I went to cancel it before the week was up, I saw that it charged me for a year subscription on the day it was supposed to start the trial, and I couldn’t do anything about it. I wish I could get my money back, I rarely even let my kid use the app, but I doubt the company cares considering all the bad reviews about payment. Truly disappointing, I don’t understand what others see in this app.
